title: Mindanao tourism to take spotlight in Sultan Kudarat expo

blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY — Tourism officials and industry players from across Mindanao are all set for the trade expo in Sultan Kudarat, which will strengthen regional travel links and promote the island as a more connected tourism circuit. The Department of Tourism (DOT) in Soccsksargen (Region 12) will host the 4th Mindanao Tourism Expo (MTEX) from Oct. 2 to 5 in Isulan town, with the Sultan Kudarat provincial government as co-host. DOT-Soccsksargen said the four-day event, themed “One Mindanao, Endless Wonders,” will bring together DOT regional offices to promote tourism in Mindanao’s six regions.
